meta.title: DawaCheck — check your medicine
meta.description: Find a cheaper Jan Aushadhi generic, check batch safety alerts and fair prices, using public government data.

home.tagline: Check your medicine in seconds: cheaper generic, safety alerts, fair price.
home.scanBody: Take photos of the front and back

checks.duplicates: Same ingredient in two family medicines

home.privacy: Your photos and location stay on your phone.
home.kendraBody: See the 3 nearest Kendras, with directions

common.disclaimer: DawaCheck gives information from public government data. It is not medical advice. Always consult your doctor or pharmacist before changing any medicine.

kendras.title: Nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra
kendras.intro: Find the 3 Jan Aushadhi Kendras closest to you.
kendras.pinUnknown: We don't know this PIN code yet. Try a nearby PIN code, or use your location.
kendras.pinApprox: Using the approximate centre of your PIN code area.
kendras.locationDenied: Location was not shared. You can type your PIN code instead.
kendras.privacy: Your location stays on your phone. Distances are worked out on your phone, not on our server.
kendras.noneNearby: No Jan Aushadhi Kendra within 10 km. These are the closest:
kendras.noneAtAll: We couldn't find any Kendra near this place.
kendras.stockNote: Stock is not published, so please call before you go.
kendras.mapNote: The map comes from OpenStreetMap, which will see the map area (not your exact location).
kendras.straightLine: Distances are in a straight line; the road may be longer.
kendras.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

scan.title: Scan your medicine strip
scan.stepFront: Step 1 of 2: front of the strip
scan.stepBack: Step 2 of 2: back of the strip
scan.frontHint: Photograph the side with the medicine name.
scan.backHint: Photograph the side with the batch number, expiry date and MRP.
scan.tip1: Lay the strip flat, in good light.
scan.tip2: Tilt it slightly so the foil doesn't shine.
scan.tip3: Fill the photo with the strip and keep the text sharp.
scan.loadingModel: Getting the reader ready (first time only)…
scan.privacyPhoto: Photos are read on your phone and never uploaded.
scan.confirmIntro: Fix anything that is wrong. Fields marked "Please check" were hard to read.
scan.ingredientsHint: One per line, for example: Telmisartan 40 mg
scan.notRead: Not found. Type it if you can see it on the strip.
scan.error: Couldn't read this photo. Try again in better light, or type the name instead.
scan.demoNote: Demo: uses sample photos made for testing, not a real medicine.
